description.p: Aerie plays live wallpapers on the COSMIC desktop and lock screen, in the spirit of Wallpaper Engine. Import the wallpapers you have, find free ones, or make your own.

ul.li: Pictures, animated GIFs, videos, web pages and web sites
2D parallax wallpapers whose layers move with your mouse and pulse with music
Shadertoy-style shaders, with sliders for their settings and an optional music input
3D: Blender scenes (.glb) and scenes you build from Poly Haven skies and models
Wallpaper Engine wallpapers from the Steam Workshop, a folder or a zip, and Lively web wallpapers
Discover: free public-domain pictures from Openverse and CC0 skies and models from Poly Haven, credited
An AI that finds a picture, writes a shader or builds a 3D scene from your words, using Ollama on your computer, Claude or ChatGPT
Widgets over your wallpaper and an optional live lock screen
Pauses while you use a maximized or full-screen app, so games get full speed
No accounts, ads or tracking. Online features stay off until you turn them on

description.p: Made for the COSMIC desktop on Pop!_OS; works on other Wayland desktops that support layer-shell. Aerie is not affiliated with Wallpaper Engine. Previously called Deskscape.

screenshot.caption: Your desktop with a live wallpaper and widgets
Aerie Studio: your library with a live preview
Make a wallpaper with the AI or by hand

description.p: A new Aerie, built around wallpapers.

ul.li: New wallpaper types: shaders, 2D parallax, 3D scenes from Poly Haven, and music-reactive wallpapers
Discover finds free pictures, skies and 3D models online, with credits
The AI now makes wallpapers: it finds art, writes shaders and builds 3D scenes, and ChatGPT can paint
Studio redesigned, with a new teal look, filters by type and a live preview of your edits
New bundled wallpapers, all CC0 or public domain
Removed the hub, clipboard history, speed test and COSMIC restyling. Delete-data and uninstall still give back any COSMIC look an older version changed

description.p: A calmer look and faster, smoother controls.

ul.li: A new ink-and-vermilion look with solid panels in place of frosted glass, and a new icon
Everything moves on spring physics, and you can interrupt any animation
Ctrl+K searches every page, action and wallpaper in the hub and in Aerie Studio
Deleting a wallpaper, to-do or clipboard item shows an Undo button instead of asking first
Drag the hub up to close it; drag the wallpaper carousel sideways to flip through it
Wallpaper previews show a soft blur of their colors while they load
You choose whether the design assistant sees a description of your desktop

description.p: A full redesign: Aerie is now a live wallpaper app, like Wallpaper Engine.

ul.li: Blender 3D scenes (.glb) as live wallpapers, and as Aerie's default themes
Wallpaper Engine wallpapers from the Steam Workshop, folders or zip files; Lively web wallpapers; your own videos, pictures, web pages and web sites
A new hub that drops down from the top of the screen (Super+D): controls, today, stats, clipboard history, apps, wallpapers and power
Aerie Studio: a separate window for your library and every setting, with a live preview
An optional live lock screen
A new look throughout

description.p: Eight all-new looks and more to build with.

ul.li: New looks: Lavender Dusk, Sea Breeze, Winter Pines, Blossom Park, Midnight City, Crystal Nebula, Desert Dunes and Lantern Lake
New ground cover: lavender, pine forest, ocean waves and sand dunes
New 3D objects: trees, pine trees, rocks, city towers with lit windows and paper lanterns
Falling petals particles
The design assistant knows about everything new
A new name, icon and a friendlier editor
An optional AI design assistant (Claude, ChatGPT or a local Ollama model)
Five new hand-made looks
Your Deskscape setup, saved looks and pictures carry over automatically
